source.name: CEPII BACI
source.productCodeMetadata: Product-code metadata is shipped within the official HS22 archive.
source.labelCrossCheck: TradeWeave public HS22 product endpoint was used only to verify selected product labels: https://tradeweave.org/api/v1/product/{hs6}/trade?revision=HS22&year=2023&limit=1
source.limitations: The raw bilateral archive and its country-code crosswalk were not materialized in this execution. Product label checks are not bilateral partner evidence.

aragonite.note: No distinct HS22 six-digit identity was verified; generic sand/stone codes would mix unrelated minerals.

basalt.note: Building-stone and aggregate codes are broader than basalt and cannot isolate this raw resource.

bauxite.note: HS22 code covers aluminium ores and concentrates, not bauxite alone.

boron.note: Natural borates are covered, but the code also includes related borates and boric acid.

chromite.note: The product label is chromium ores and concentrates; it does not identify chromite alone.

coal.note: The selected codes cover anthracite, bituminous coal, other coal and lignite; mapping is not a one-code identity.

cobalt.note: HS22 product is cobalt ores and concentrates.

construction_aggregate.note: The product is pebbles, gravel and broken/crushed stone commonly used as concrete aggregate or road/rail ballast; other aggregate forms are not identified.

copper.note: HS22 product is copper ores and concentrates.

coral_aggregate.note: Generic aggregate classifications do not isolate coral-derived aggregate.

crude_oil.note: HS22 product is crude petroleum oils and oils obtained from bituminous minerals.

diamond.note: The three HS22 codes cover unsorted, industrial unworked and non-industrial unworked diamonds; worked or mounted diamonds are excluded.

diatomite.note: HS22 product includes diatomite but also other siliceous fossil meals and similar siliceous earths.

dolomite.note: HS22 product is natural dolomite not calcined or sintered.

gold.note: The HS22 code aggregates precious-metal ores other than silver and cannot isolate gold from other precious metals.

granite.note: HS22 products identify granite, crude/roughly trimmed and cut into blocks/slabs.

graphite.note: HS22 products identify natural graphite in powder/flakes and other natural forms.

gypsum.note: HS22 product identifies gypsum and anhydrite.

ilmenite.note: HS22 titanium ores and concentrates do not distinguish ilmenite from rutile.

iron_ore.note: HS22 products identify non-agglomerated and agglomerated iron ores and concentrates.

limestone.note: HS22 product covers limestone flux and other calcareous stone of a kind used for lime or cement, not every limestone use.

lithium.note: Lithium carbonate (283691) is a processed compound, not the raw lithium resource identity; no verified distinct raw-ore HS22 code is used.

magnesite.note: HS22 product is natural magnesium carbonate (magnesite).

manganese.note: HS22 product is manganese ores and concentrates.

marble.note: The HS22 products include marble and travertine in rough or cut block form; the code does not isolate marble from travertine.

natural_gas.note: HS22 products identify liquefied natural gas and natural gas in gaseous state.

nickel.note: HS22 product is nickel ores and concentrates.

niobium.note: HS22 product combines niobium, tantalum and vanadium ores and concentrates.

oil_shale.note: HS22 product combines bituminous shale, oil shale and tar sands; it cannot isolate oil shale.

phosphate.note: HS22 products cover unground and ground natural calcium/aluminium phosphates and phosphatic chalk.

platinum.note: The HS22 code aggregates precious-metal ores other than silver and cannot isolate platinum-group ore.

potash.note: Potassium chloride fertilizer (310420) is a processed product and is not substituted for raw potash.

rare_earth.note: Rare-earth metals and compounds (for example 280530 or 284690) are not raw rare-earth ore; no distinct raw identity is accepted.

ruby.note: HS22 product combines many precious and semi-precious stones and does not isolate ruby.

rutile.note: HS22 titanium ores and concentrates do not distinguish rutile from ilmenite.

salt.note: HS22 product aggregates salt, table salt, denatured salt, sodium chloride and sea water.

silver.note: HS22 product is silver ores and concentrates.

tin.note: HS22 product is tin ores and concentrates.

tungsten.note: HS22 product is tungsten ores and concentrates.

uranium.note: HS22 product is uranium ores and concentrates.

zinc.note: HS22 product is zinc ores and concentrates.
